ArrayParamModel.description:
ArrayParam: rows copied from ``template``. A PerColumnArrayParam has a row per input column,
each labelled with it, and none can be added or removed; a FileArrayParam's rows are files,
added by choosing them.
ArrayParamModel.title: ArrayParamModel

BooleanParamModel.description: BooleanParam. None is a parameter never set, which CountESS reads (and the GUI shows) as false.
BooleanParamModel.title: BooleanParamModel

ChoiceOption.description:
``value`` is what is sent to choose it and what a pipeline saves; ``label`` is what is shown.
They differ only for a DictChoiceParam.
ChoiceOption.title: ChoiceOption

ChoiceParamModel.description:
ChoiceParam and its family (column choices, data types), and DictChoiceParam. ``selected`` is
the value chosen, which may be one no longer among the options (a column that has gone).
ChoiceParamModel.title: ChoiceParamModel

Column.description: A column of a node's table: its name, and its DuckDB type as DuckDB writes it.
Column.title: Column

ColumnOrValueParamModel.description:
ColumnOrStringParam and ColumnOrIntegerParam: either a value typed in, or a column of the input
to take each row's value from. Exactly one of ``value`` and ``column`` is set, or neither.
ColumnOrValueParamModel.title: ColumnOrValueParamModel

DecimalParamModel.description: DecimalParam, its value as exact decimal text.
DecimalParamModel.title: DecimalParamModel

DownloadLink.description: A link that downloads one file, once, within a minute.
DownloadLink.title: DownloadLink

EventHello.description: The first message the browser sends on the event socket.
EventHello.title: EventHello

FileParamModel.description: FileParam: a file to read. ``absolute`` is it resolved against the pipeline's folder.
FileParamModel.title: FileParamModel

FileType.description: One entry of a file parameter's ``file_types``, its patterns as globs.
FileType.title: FileType

FloatParamModel.description: FloatParam. None is an empty value.
FloatParamModel.title: FloatParamModel

GroupParamModel.description:
MultiParam. ``layout`` is CountESS's hint for drawing it: TabularMultiParam is a table row,
FramedMultiParam a frame of its own.
GroupParamModel.title: GroupParamModel

IntegerParamModel.description: IntegerParam. None is an empty value.
IntegerParamModel.title: IntegerParamModel

MultiChoiceParamModel.description: MultiChoiceParam (MultiColumnChoiceParam): any number of ``choices``, in their order.
MultiChoiceParamModel.title: MultiChoiceParamModel

Node.description:
A PipelineNode. ``position`` is CountESS's (across, down), each from 0 to 1. ``message`` is the
traceback of a failed preview, empty for a node that made no table without failing (a CSV Save,
say). ``sortColumn`` and ``sortDescending`` are the preview's sort, which a pipeline saves.
Node.title: Node

NodePlugin.description: A node's plugin (BasePlugin): its class's attributes.
NodePlugin.title: NodePlugin

ParameterChange.description:
A change to the parameter at ``path``: a new ``value``, or for a column-or-value parameter a
``column`` to take it from; or adding a row to a list, adding files to a file list, or deleting
row ``index``.
ParameterChange.title: ParameterChange

PluginInfo.description: A plugin class from the countess_plugins entry points, by ``module:Class``.
PluginInfo.title: PluginInfo

Preview.description:
Rows ``offset`` on of a node's preview table. Each cell is its DuckDB value as JSON: a number,
text, true or false, null, or a list or object for a nested type. Sent as exact text: a DECIMAL,
an integer a browser cannot hold exactly (beyond 2**53, as a BIGINT or HUGEINT can be), a time
with a time zone, an infinite or not-a-number float, and other values JSON lacks.
Preview.title: Preview

PreviewSave.description: Save Preview CSV; a file already there is replaced only if ``overwrite``.
PreviewSave.title: PreviewSave

RunOutput.description:
A file a save node was set to write when the run started; ``written`` if this run wrote it.
``error`` is why its template named no file.
RunOutput.title: RunOutput

SaveFileParamModel.description:
FileSaveParam: a file to write. ``inOutputDir`` is a relative OutputFileParam (CSV Save's
filename), which each run writes in its own output directory; otherwise ``absolute`` is the file,
resolved against the pipeline's folder.
SaveFileParamModel.title: SaveFileParamModel

SavedPreview.description: Where a preview was saved, on the server, and a link that downloads it once within a minute.
SavedPreview.title: SavedPreview

StateEvent.description:
Sent when any node's status, or the graph's version or modified flag, changes. A new
``version`` means the graph itself changed and should be fetched again.
StateEvent.title: StateEvent

StringParamModel.description:
StringParam (ColumnLabelParam, StringCharacterSetParam). ``characterSet``, when set, is every
character the value may hold; CountESS uppercases a lowercase letter it allows only in upper case,
and drops any other character.
StringParamModel.title: StringParamModel

Workflow.description:
countess.core.workflow.WorkflowInfo: a short name and a semantic version, either unset; the
output directory template each run's files go in; and whether CSV files start with a metadata
header.
Workflow.title: Workflow

WorkflowUpdate.description:
The whole workflow, replacing what it was. An empty string or null unsets the name or version,
and makes the output directory the default.
WorkflowUpdate.title: WorkflowUpdate
